verdict.rationale: Rootly documents overrides as part of its schedules, advertises mobile shift swaps and overrides, and says Rootly AI can create overrides, which points to responder-side changes without rebuilding the schedule. The swap evidence is a single pricing-page bullet, and nothing shows a coverage-request flow. missing for 10: request-coverage workflow, explicit docs that non-admin on-call engineers can self-serve overrides and swaps, detailed shift-swap documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule

citations.quote: Create, manage, and maintain on-call schedules in Rootly with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews to keep coverage clear and predictable.
Rootly AI can now create overrides, look up who's on call, create retrospectives, and answer questions about Rootly.
